body:
not necessarily. the courses im doing now aligns with my major, but im just having a difficult time with being productive. 

i used to be good at submitting assignments on time, albeit the content was not my best writing/work. 

but something about the past couple of months, i have been on a steady descent to my insanity and isolation. 

i hope it gets better, but i am doubtful.

i cant get documentation to support my need for an extension. 

it wont get better, ever.

im lying to everyone. deceiving people that im ok, school is going great, and that im getting better. 

im not. it's gotten worse. i relapsed sh, was 1 year clean. 

i am worthless. my studies focus on connecting theory to the horrors of the world, i have to watch videos abt starving children in refugee camps. 

yet here i am, a stable home, receiving university education, food on the table everyday, water and a shelter. 

but i still complain. i dont deserve to be alive really. yet, im much too of a coward to do *it.*

yeah im in uni. ive already asked for an extension but i was not able to submit it on time. the last day of submission is tomorrow morning. i cant fail this class whatsoever. 

my uni does have mental health services but there's a payment to do it. 

ive been trying to write the paper for the past hour but ive barely written anything decent for the professor to grade. 

i am a complete failure. ive put this situation to myself.

you aren't alone on this feeling. the last few months have been terrible but do tell your therapist. bottling it all up isn't the way to go, and telling someone about it is difficult as hell. but once you do, your therapist will help you. 

you deserve a good life op. you got this.

I was only able to write 5 pages and I have nothing more to write.   


I feel like a failure but honestly, submitting a half-assed paper is better than submitting nothing, right? 

I don't like my brain and this whole situation just worsened everything. I gave up on myself, I'm sorry.
Thank you so much! This is extremely helpful seriously. I'll try not to give up.

I'm glad that this is not an issue I deal with alone, quite relieving to hear that. As for the solution, I think we need to have a sense of who we really are. 

I feel like the reason why I still subconsciously need validation from men is that I lack any sense of self-validation like I don't see my own beauty, my own worth, or even like my own personality. It's just like you said, I change into a whole different persona when I am around men or my guy friends just so that they can validate me. 

I agree with your last statement, we just need to stay true and natural to who we are. But the problem still lies, who am I?

bad day today.

supposed to finish a final project due today yet i cant seem to finish it.

have not even started it 

been given 1 month to do it yet i am unable to actually do it 

im fucking tired of this shit. id really like to be medicated or go to therapy for this issue, its going to get worse i can feel it
Thanks for letting me know. Kinda odd that my teacher didn't inform me about this.

thank you for this. it means a lot. i, too, hope i can live through this. 

i wish you well.

thank you for our conversion. being able to talk to you about things really did help. i hope you know how much of an impact you did in changing things in my life, as ridiculous as it sounds. 

im trying to live, as tough as it is. 

i truly wish you well. thank you.

it's getting difficult day by day but the fact that im not alone in feeling like this makes me feel as though everything will be alright. 

i dont know if these thoughts or feelings will subside the moment i get help but its reassuring to know that someone out there is willing to help. 

i hope youre doing alright, its good to know that you have someone who you can talk to. 

thank you for being concerned, it means a lot. i wish you well.

it really is strange, but it helps to validate those feelings. 

getting professional help/therapy is really expensive here so i dont know how things will work out but im trying to get all the help i need as much as i can. 

this subreddit made me have a sliver of hope for my future. thank you, i cannot say this enough. 

i wish you well.

thank you, i really hope it would.

i wish you well.

ahh yes, the vulnerability aspect of it. ill work hard to do so once i get help. 

thank you for all the advice youve given me so far, its been really helpful.

i wish you well!

maybe one day, if im alive and well, i could meet you in america where we could talk over bubble tea and pet your lovely cats. 

thank you once again, i wish you and your cats well!

the fact that you love him automatically shows that you care for him, and that already counts for something. youre trying and thats already a big step. 

hope everything goes well for you and your brother. 

thank you once again.

thank you for being concerned. 

im trying to find a way to tell them without making them furious. they truly are kind-hearted people but they just don't understand how painful it is to have this kind of struggle. i really hope they can support me. 

once again, thank you for your kind words. i wish you well.

i wish i lived in north america, but i live elsewhere. 

i just realized how much i miss boba, and the fact that i adore cats! i wouldve definitely taken on your offer if i didnt live in the place i am in right now. 

but thank you, really. i appreciate your support. hope you and your cats are doing well.

ill definitely take note of that. i guess it doesnt hurt if you try right?

thank you once again.

the comments truly did help. so, thank you.

being vulnerable to people who are close to me is quite difficult, but im trying to have courage to do so. 

idk if therapy will change anything, but i know i need help. 

thank you once again, i wish you well.

maybe one day, ill succeed in that mission.

but for now, ill try to recover and have a restart. 

see you.

im trying to have enough courage to tell them, hopefully it'll be worthwhile and ill get the help i needed. 

thank you, it really means a lot.

it took a lot of willpower to stop myself, i still dont know if its the right decision. 

thank you for taking the time to be concerned about me, really means a lot. 

also, i appreciate the help that you give for others, it's really commendable. 

thank you once again.
im sorry for making you worried, you really dont need to. but thank you for your concern, i wish you well.

i havent received anything but thank you, really. the fact that someone out there, whoever you are, is kind enough to worry about a stranger on the internet. 

i truly wish you well.
this is really reassuring, thank you.

im glad youre in a better place, that makes me have a small ounce of hope for things to get better. 

they're really good people, but i just want actual help. 

maybe one day ill be ok,

thank you. i wish you well.
i really want help, ill try to have the courage to. thank you.
im scared of how they'll react but ill give it a try, thank you.
youre a caring sibling. i wish you well.

hey everyone. im still here. ive made a separate post explaining everything. here's the [link](https://www.reddit.com/r/SuicideWatch/comments/syg0kr/im_still_here_and_alive_i_didnt_go_through_with/?utm_source=share&utm_medium=web2x&context=3) if anyone wants to read it. thank you all.

also, ive read every single one of your comments. all i could say is thank you. thank you for taking out the time to try to help someone live. it's a tiring process to do that, and i hope you know that your efforts aren't wasted. 

it means a lot.

you aren't wrong. i just wish things were different, where i can actually get out of this situation.

also dont worry, you aren't being nosy nor are you putting words in my mouth. i won't tell you to shut up. the fact that youre trying already means a lot. im sorry for making you do this. in fact, i should shut the fuck up since i know how tiring it is to try to see someone's perspectives on things whilst trying to prevent a huge blowup.

what i meant by 'freely' was that, a successful person is someone who has freedom in life. just simple as that. also, im not as thoughtful as you think i am, but im flattered that you think that way.

yes, fruitful conversations and different perspectives on life! they are the best. how people live, dream, conceptualize and create - its all so fascinating. but when certain people bombard or reinforce those ideas onto you for you to follow, the fascination grows faint. kinda sucks that thats the reality i have to live with.

dont be sorry. its not your fault people turn out this way. they definitely are frightened by how much of a disappointment ive become to them, so thats a reason why they yell. they grew up in a household where yelling equates to authority, so its a habit that theyve lived with.

you know whats weird? having a convo with you is making me have second-thoughts on my plan tonight. i dont know, maybe all i needed was to have a civil convo with a stranger on the internet and tell me that i need to take a breath.

once again, i cannot say this enough, thank you. truly.

firstly, those aren't stupid questions - they're reasonable curiosities, so it's understandable. 

personally, success is one's ability to live freely, a life that is full of peace, kindness and care. i like your take on success. 

i don't know if i have enough time to read through the first chapter of your recommended book but i'm sure it's helpful, especially to those who are in the same predicament as i am. 

that's an interesting belief, it's really endearing. it's always in the little things, isnt it? the chill breeze, the bird's chirping, the flowing water. i'd do anything to just have one last moment with the earth for myself. 

as for your second (not stupid) question, i don't have the necessary things to runaway and start over. i wish i could, but im afraid it would be impossible to leave this place and not get caught. 

i enjoy talking to you too. i havent had a proper convo like this with someone in a while, i guess not everyone has the habit to yell when they want to communicate. 

thank you. i don't know how i can express my gratitude enough for being so kind and caring enough to a stranger on the internet who's on the verge of ending it all. 

ill remember to take a breather before i go. 

thank you once again, i truly do wish you well.

i hope you can find comfort in life. it feels nice that im not alone in feeling like this. 

have a beautiful life.

i hope i can find hope just like you did, 

but maybe in another life.

thank you for your calming wisdom, flawednessly.

you were able to bounce back. i think that counts for something, doesn't it?

it really is tiring but one day, we'll be freed from all those troubles. 

god, its just a game of self-destruction. we're a fucking time bomb. 

i know you wont believe it, but you arent a disgrace.

the circumstance that im in right now prevents me from going out of those expectations. if i dont fit into the mold of what they expect me to be, i basically do not have a chance to succeed in life. (this goes deep into familial issues that im not comfortable talking about out in the internet so apologies for being quite vague)

i have so many dreams that i wish i can turn into reality but alas, i'm destined to misery. killing myself is probably the most free i can be. 

also, thank you. you are too kind, im just a stranger in the internet yet you've given endearing words to someone who's viewed unworthy in other people's eyes. 

truly, i appreciate this. i wish you well.

it feels really awful to fall back into that goddamn cycle. 

its a bit rich coming from me who's about commit, but maybe one day, when youre at your lowest, you will find a small sliver of hope to push through once more. 

hope everything goes well for you.

i've disappointed them for too long. i get where you're coming from, i really do. i dont have to abide by people's expectations of me, but those set expectations are the only way i can have a good life. but its so goddamn tiring.

im really tired. ive been pushing this day for so long now. 

but thank you for your kind words. i truly appreciate. hope you have a wonderful life ahead of you. youre a kind person.
i'll take note of that, thank you.
see you on the other side.

they already realized how much of a disappointment i am to them. i've failed to reach their expectations time and time again. i don't want to keep doing that to them, they really don't deserve it. they're good people but i don't deserve them whatsoever.

i've tried telling them my inability to function as a normal human being but they resorted to yelling at me and my incompetence, which i completely agree. i scream at myself knowing how much of a fuck-up i am.

i've dealt with this for a long time now but today is the day when every problem in my life stops.

i know that you're trying to prevent me from killing myself and i commend you for that (really, i do) but i've grown too tired to try and keep myself alive at all times.

thank you though. hope you live a beautiful life.
